Singapore to Chair ASEAN Amidst Regional Challenges

Singapore is set to assume the chairmanship of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) on January 1, taking over from the Philippines. Observers believe Singapore is well-positioned to lead the bloc through its 60th anniversary year and navigate regional crises. The city-state is also addressing internal demographic challenges through financial and cultural initiatives.
